title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 142 ]

blocks.text: To keep a pleasant working environment, employers cannot allow certain kinds of behaviors such as arriving late or bothering others. These behaviors may weaken the group work environment and decrease productivity. So employers always consider teamwork when they judge a worker's performance. They look for employees who support each other, take pride in their work, and encourage a pleasant working environment. Respect, good manners, and thoughtful behaviors are keys to successful teamwork. In fact, working well with others is one of the most important job skills.

readingSentences.english: To keep a pleasant working environment, employers cannot allow certain kinds of behaviors such as arriving late or bothering others.
readingSentences.korean: 쾌적한 근무 환경을 유지하기 위해 고용주는 지각이나 남을 귀찮게 하는 것 같은 행동을 용납할 수 없다.

readingSentences.english: These behaviors may weaken the group work environment and decrease productivity.
readingSentences.korean: 이런 행동은 함께 일하는 환경을 해치고 생산성을 떨어뜨릴 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: So employers always consider teamwork when they judge a worker's performance.
readingSentences.korean: 그래서 고용주는 직원의 성과를 평가할 때 늘 팀워크를 고려한다.

readingSentences.english: They look for employees who support each other, take pride in their work, and encourage a pleasant working environment.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 서로 돕고, 자기 일에 자부심을 갖고, 쾌적한 근무 환경을 만드는 직원을 찾는다.

readingSentences.english: Respect, good manners, and thoughtful behaviors are keys to successful teamwork.
readingSentences.korean: 존중, 좋은 매너, 사려 깊은 행동이 성공적인 팀워크의 열쇠다.

readingSentences.english: In fact, working well with others is one of the most important job skills.
readingSentences.korean: 사실 다른 사람들과 잘 일하는 것은 가장 중요한 직무 능력 가운데 하나다.
